items.title: APT28 (Fancy Bear, Sofacy) — Russia — GRU 85th Main Special Service Center, Unit 26165
items.summary: 2016 DNC intrusion; credential harvesting via compromised Ubiquiti EdgeRouters; Outlook elevation-of-privilege exploitation (CVE-2023-23397).

items.title: APT29 (Cozy Bear, NOBELIUM) — Russia — Foreign Intelligence Service (SVR)
items.summary: SolarWinds Orion supply-chain compromise (2020); sustained targeting of government, think-tank, and research networks; cloud/identity-focused TTPs.

items.title: Sandworm (Voodoo Bear, Seashell Blizzard) — Russia — GRU Main Center for Special Technologies, Unit 74455
items.summary: Ukraine power-grid attacks (2015/2016); NotPetya (2017); Olympic Destroyer; sustained operations against Ukrainian critical infrastructure.

items.title: Turla (Snake, Venomous Bear) — Russia — FSB Center 16
items.summary: Long-running espionage; Snake implant (disrupted by Operation MEDUSA, 2023); satellite C2 abuse.

items.title: Gamaredon (Primitive Bear, Armageddon) — Russia — FSB (attributed by SSU of Ukraine)
items.summary: High-volume spear-phishing against Ukrainian government and military entities.

items.title: Star Blizzard (Callisto, SEABORGIUM) — Russia — FSB Center 18
items.summary: Credential-phishing of NGOs, academics, journalists, and government targets.
